readerCopy.body: Someone else's life can become unusually magnetic when it seems to contain the permission missing from the current arrangement. When Neptune opposes Lilith, imagination and autonomy face each other directly, making a crush, friend, public figure, relationship, or imagined future carry a desire that is difficult to name directly. Envy and idealization can both point toward something missing without making the other person's life the answer. The feeling becomes more useful once the desired freedom, attention, privacy, intimacy, or change is named on its own terms.
